newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn slips, soy and wheat steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn slips, soy and wheat steady.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf corn basis offers slipped two cents a bushel in the April positions while soybean and wheat values were steady, export sources said.

Dealers cited a quiet market despite a slowdown in barge traffic near Baton Rouge, La. High water last week caused several barge incidents near Baton Rouge and prompted the U.S. Coast Guard to issue restrictions on marine traffic there.

In export news, Egypt's official Holding Company for Rice and Flour Mills said it bought 100,000 tonnes of Australian hard wheat and 50,000 tonnes of either Australian or U.S. hard red wheat. Shipment was slated for April-May delivery.
